structuredContent.name: tenants.remove-user-from-tenant
structuredContent.description: Remove a user's membership from an active tenant, revoking the user's role in that tenant. Allowed for a global administrator or a TenantOwner of the tenant; removing a user who is not a member is rejected. Removing the last TenantOwner is allowed; afterwards only a global administrator can manage the tenant's members, roles and configuration.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant to remove the user from.

UserId.description: Identifier of the member to remove: the subject (sub) claim the identity provider issues for that user.
